scope: Actual Hono createApp Request/Response routing, JWT and SQL role authorization, controller/service/transaction graph against isolated native PostgreSQL 16.15. Not a live HTTP listener, browser, workerd, deployed Hyperdrive, Redis or real provider acceptance run.

evidence.initialTypecheckFailure: Worker all-source typecheck found missing unknown JSON response guards and Hono Response | Promise<Response> handling in the new unit tests. Added runtime object/envelope checks and async send; no any/double cast, suppression, relaxed assertion or tsconfig change. The runtime-only config excludes root unit tests and was not used as a substitute.
safeguards: Create is SQL-only and original key replay spans both aliases.
Execute commits creation before financial admission/settlement; errors may follow committed creation.
Missing lookup is not a fence; abandonment fences only an uncreated key and cannot cancel a created application/payment.
Changed body under original key conflicts; current owner identity is checked in middleware and again after streamed body reads.
Real native peers verify single application/balance effect and creation-versus-abandonment ordering using observed blocking PIDs.
WeChat/Alipay UNKNOWN synthetic transport preserves creation and admitted operation; explicit original execution queries and settles without a second request.
In-flight duplicate sees committed evidence and an existing provider lease.
Receipt insertion failure proves either full creation rollback or durable creation plus separately rolled-back financial effects.
Missing schema never triggers HTTP installation.
Creation/settlement evidence survives business deletion and current policy changes; newly stale source facts are rejected.
Malformed/oversized/invalid UTF-8/keyless legacy input, alternate methods and post-auth privilege changes do not dispatch unauthorized writes.
evidence.providerTransport: Only WechatPayService/AlipayRefundService request/query methods are simulated; unconfigured fetch and provider I/O fail closed. No real payment/refund.
evidence.databaseRole: finance_test NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEROLE on newly owned loopback clusters; not proof of the production full-application least-privilege role.
